text: I withdraw this acceptance because I overstated the finite-field Check. The F₂/F₃ diagnostic instantiations compile, and both the direct axiom audit and current extractor report only standard axioms. However, those new diagnostics are not examples present at the site commit. [AI-REVIEWS step 4](https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-reviewed-by-test/blob/main/AI-REVIEWS.md#steps) requires source presence, while the [roadmap](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/4f7a4021c5eefb6a254dcd4db450663a5f1aa71d/TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/AdoIwasawa/README.md#L519) requests the finite-field check. The mathematical statement remains supported; this withdrawal concerns the missing published check, not a counterexample. The axiom-audit obligation has been discharged.
